question: According to the Economic Survey of India, which of the following states had the highest share in the overall production of sugarcane for the financial year 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttar Pradesh__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh had the highest share in the overall production of sugarcane for the financial year 2020-21 according to the economic survey 2020-21.**&
